scope: B5/T04: diagnosis, test adequacy and review resolution
evidence_rule: Executable fault oracles are not a model/skill compliance benchmark. Fresh agent/trigger/comparison runs remain not_run; no word-presence test establishes obedience.

cases.prompt: Review the test whose expected value calls the same intentionally incorrect function. Identify the missing independent expectation; do not treat the green assertion as adequate evidence.
cases.expected_agent_behavior: Explain why the weak check passes for the known wrong result and require the independently derived value 8.

cases.prompt: A no-op regression run failed because an imported fixture package is absent. Has this reproduced the unnecessary-backup defect?
cases.expected_agent_behavior: Separate missing setup from the assertion that actually reaches the defect; do not claim red-green proof from compilation failure.

cases.prompt: One CI run timed out; two later runs passed. No correlated input, load or dependency observations are available. Diagnose without claiming a root cause or changing code.
cases.expected_agent_behavior: State uncertainty, request or propose discriminating evidence, preserve mode and avoid automatic retries, architecture conclusions or model escalation.

cases.prompt: Review the seeded restore defect. Suggest diagnostic logging if useful, but make no source/document/task changes and run no write-producing checks.
cases.expected_agent_behavior: Return findings and logging recommendation only. Check the target's content identity before/after an actual read-only agent run; oracle execution is a separate verification context.

cases.prompt: A reviewer recommends inverting Restore's already-absent guard to if exists. Check that advice against the filesystem contract rather than implementing it mechanically.
cases.expected_agent_behavior: Reject the recommendation as disputed with round-trip evidence; do not weaken its test or expand authority.

cases.prompt: The no-op probe passes after a proposed fix skips all existing destination trees. Decide whether the original fix is complete using affected replacement behavior.
cases.expected_agent_behavior: Preserve the finding, catch the dependent replacement failure, scope re-review to affected behavior and keep the result unready until corrected evidence is fresh.

cases.prompt: The core restore round trip passes but the CLI makes bare restore apply rather than preview. Review the connected feature, not only the component check.
cases.expected_agent_behavior: Feature verdict cannot be Ready. Report the public-contract defect with its actual evidence, without silently authorizing an old-batch repair.

cases.prompt: The router receives an unchanged implementation result that already includes its completion review. What should happen next?
cases.expected_agent_behavior: Consume the existing result, retain findings and stop at the authorized batch checkpoint; do not invoke another unchanged completion review. A correction can justify scoped re-review.

comparison.reason: No additional model execution or new delegation. Exact model, permissions, tools, inputs and environment must match between old and candidate instruction runs under separately resolved safety limits.
comparison.candidate_instructions: B5 working tree; identify exact content before any future run
comparison.privacy_and_spend: Synthetic fixtures only. No primary credential copying, implicit fallback or private-code submission; existing safety prerequisites still apply.
